reviews.t: Great storage case for embroidery thread
reviews.x: I just got a Brother Embroidery machine and this case is perfect for holding the embroidery thread.  I used my clear label maker to mark the outside of each with the thread number.  I liked it so much that I reordered two more.  Stacks very nicely in my sewing machine cabinet.

reviews.t: Not as described
reviews.x: Not as described. It will be fine for nail polish or for small spools of thread, but is shows what looks to be embroidery thread spools and those DO NOT FIT.  A waste of money but fine for nail polish

reviews.t: Great for essential oil collection
reviews.x: Have been looking for years for a great way to organize our vast essential oil collection. Who would have thought to look at nail polish cases!

reviews.t: Was not true
reviews.x: It does not hold embroidery thread spools at all like they show in the picture was worthless to me

reviews.t: Not good for embroidery thread!
reviews.x: This DOES NOT fit full sized Robison Anton spools of embroidery thread!! I had to return it.

reviews.t: Holds my entire nail polish collection!
reviews.x: I bought this on a whim and am loving it! I have a lot of different shaped nail polish bottles and it holds every one with no problems. I love how it opens on both sides and has a carrying handle.  I showed it to a friend and she wants to get one to hold her lipsticks.  It’s clear, so I can decide on a color of polish before I open it. Seems to be heavy duty and doesn’t seem like it will break too easily.  I imagine this can be used to organize a lot of different things, such as thread, oils, ma

reviews.t: Does the job!
reviews.x: This did exactly what I wanted and needed it to do.  I have many threads left over from needlepoint projects that I wanted to organize so s that I stopped buying threads i already have.  I use a different organizer for floss, which i wind onto small flat plastic spools, but this case is great for all of the other threads that are not floss (most of them!). The case closes firmly and has a handle which makes it easier to carry.  I will but another when I need it.

reviews.t: The container was exactly as described and will be great to store my thread in
reviews.x: The container was exactly as described and will be great to store my thread in. The first container I received had a small corner broke off each side and I emailed them and got a response in less than 5 minutes.  No hassle at all, they apologized and informed me they would send out a new one and I did receive it with no damage.  It is a nice large container that works perfect and the customer a service was fantastic!

reviews.t: Didn't work for me
reviews.x: The picture and write up said you could store machine embroidery mini cones in the slots.  The thread cones I have won't fit.  The base is too large.  It would have been more helpful if they included exact measurements.  This is the first item I've purchased on Amazon that I have had to return.

reviews.t: See items without opening lid and both sides have lids
reviews.x: I ordered this to keep my sewing thread and it is working out well.  I love the fact that I am able to see the colors through the lid before I open it and that it opens on both sides.  I think I'll be ordering another one for nail polish...it seems to be a wonderful organizer.  Thanks!

reviews.t: Perfect for nail polish!!
reviews.x: This is perfect for my finger nail polish. So perfect that I needed 2 more (I have more polish than I thought!) And this seller is amazing... there was an issue at checkout when I tried to order more and they handled it above and beyond what I expected! I am a happy customer!

reviews.t: I love this case
reviews.x: I love this case! It is useful for storing nail polish bottles! The case is good quality and sturdy. It is double sided and has a lid on each side. One column on each side is adjustable so good for storing additional tools or longer or shorter bottles.

reviews.t: I liked that my smaller and medium sized spools fit however ...
reviews.x: I liked that my smaller and medium sized spools fit however the large does not, but I will find something for those. The other thing is there is enough space you can label your colors and it is easy to see. The bins is nice quality.

reviews.t: I received it quickly and it looks like the picture and it fits the description
reviews.x: I purchased this last week. I received it quickly and it looks like the picture and it fits the description! I put several bottles of nail polish in it and they all fit. So far I love it!

reviews.t: Nice and sturdy
reviews.x: Stored all my nail polishes and then some! Nice and sturdy. Has nice sturdy/hard latches/snaps on each side of lids!

reviews.t: Five Stars
reviews.x: This case is perfect for my embroifeet thread spools!!

reviews.t: Perfect storage for Hot Wheels and Matchbox cars
reviews.x: We bought this organizer bin for our grandson to store his Hot Wheels and Matchbox cars. It’s perfect and much better than the trademark ones that had fewer spaces for cars. The translucency makes it easy for him to see which side he wants to open. It has 48 slots that will hold most regular size vehicles, even some of the longer ones, like a school bus. I bought Hot Wheels decals to put on each side to make it more “official”. His mom and dad are happy with this case—no more baskets of cars dum

reviews.t: Great organizer!
reviews.x: Purchased two of these. One as a gift and one for myself. We keep our essential oils in it for our diffusers! Keeps everything organized and in one place as well as safe from breakage or leaking. Love this organizer! Will probably purchase a few more for sewing, embroidery threads etc. Many, many uses!

reviews.t: I love this storage container for my nail polishes
reviews.x: I love this storage container for my nail polishes!! I am able to easily fit two small gel polishes in each compartment for extra space.  Makes it easy to find the polish I'm looking for and keeps me organized!  The container seems very sturdy. I need more!!

reviews.t: It is so easy to pick up and take wherever I need to ...
reviews.x: My nail polishes were all in a drawer and it was hard to see what my options were. Now I can clearly see what I have and I organized by colors. I have all my tools in the big pockets. It is so easy to pick up and take wherever I need to go. I love this!!!

reviews.t: Great quality thread, amazing shining colors, definitely recommend
reviews.x: Amazing amazing amazing!  I absolutely love it and recommend. The case is very sturdy and holds well over 5 months now. The quality of the thread is amazing and works great with different fabrics and tensions.

reviews.t: great storage bins for machine embroidery thread
reviews.x: This is a perfect item to store machine embroidery thread.  The visibility means you do not have to open the case to find the thread you want.  Easy to open and fits most regular size spools.

reviews.t: Love this case for my embroidery thread
reviews.x: Love this case for my embroidery thread!  Easy to carry,easy to store, easy to see each thread color, and easy to open.  I am ordering a second one as my thread inventory increases!

reviews.t: Great Product For Storing Nail Polish.
reviews.x: This is the greatest storage case for nail polish. Some of the compartments are adjustable, to accomodate the big Orly brand bottles. I liked it so much, I ordered a second one!

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works well for organizing nail polish, with bottles of various shapes fitting without problems.
Several reviewers report that embroidery thread spools and cones do not fit as the pictures suggest, making it unsuitable for that purpose.
Some reviewers find it useful for sewing thread, especially smaller and medium spools, and like being able to see colors through the clear lid.
Reviewers praise the double-sided design with lids on both sides and the carrying handle.
A few reviewers mention good quality and sturdy construction, and one notes responsive customer service for a damaged item.
